name: get_subscriptions
description: By default, returns a list of subscriptions that have not been canceled. (GET /v1/subscriptions)

customer.description: The ID of the customer whose subscriptions will be retrieved.

price.description: Filter for subscriptions that contain this recurring price.

status.description: The status of the subscriptions to retrieve. One of incomplete, incomplete_expired, trialing, active, past_due, unpaid, canceled, or paused.

collection_method.description: The collection method of the subscriptions to retrieve. Either charge_automatically or send_invoice.

limit.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 100, and the default is 30.
